question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

The new law aims to ___________ (Enlarge) the sale of illegal drugs.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Curtail)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enlarge"** means to make something bigger, increase in size, or expand. (बड़ा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to enlarge its operations by opening more branches globally.
 
 
 
• **"Curtail"** means to reduce or limit something, especially something that is considered excessive or unnecessary. (कम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The government introduced measures to curtail the misuse of public funds.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'enlarge'** is **'curtail'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Curtail)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Amplify** (बढ़ाना): To make something louder, stronger, or more intense.

 
 
• **Example:** The speaker amplified the sound to ensure everyone in the room could hear him.
 
 
 
• **Ridicule** (मज़ाक उड़ाना): To mock or make fun of someone or something in a dismissive manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The comedian ridiculed the politician’s speech in his latest show.
 
 
 
• **Admire** (प्रशंसा करना): To regard someone or something with respect, approval, or affection.
 
 
• **Example:** She admired his dedication and hard work in completing the project.
